name: Ochre Jelly

source.note: The 2024 Ochre Jelly (2025 Monster Manual). Every number compared with the page fetched from aidedd.org (Monster Manual 2024 stat block). Split is a Reaction the engine cannot run yet (the same open gap as the Black Pudding's).

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.summary: Squeezes through a space as narrow as 1 inch without extra movement cost.
traits.text: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without spending extra movement.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.summary: Climbs difficult surfaces, ceilings included, with no ability check.
traits.text: The jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without making an ability check.

reactions.name: Split
reactions.trigger: While Large or Medium with 10+ Hit Points, it becomes Bloodied or is subjected to Lightning or Slashing damage
reactions.summary: Large or Medium with 10+ HP, becoming Bloodied or hit by Lightning or Slashing: splits into two jellies one size smaller, sharing its HP.
reactions.text: Response: it splits into two new Ochre Jellies, each one size smaller, acting on its Initiative. The original's Hit Points are divided evenly between them (rounded down).

summary: A creeping acid ooze that climbs walls and splits when it is cut or shocked.
